objective: Learn measured wall, floor, and ceiling detail only inside a narrow tangent-SDF boundary band, distill it to one runtime evaluation, and prove that neither teacher nor student can alter the deterministic regional topology contract
split_unit: entire cave system and acquisition campaign

base_anatomy.name: source-balanced contextual retrieval envelope
base_anatomy.construction: CW7 leave-one-source-out per-source KNN mean followed by 2D Gaussian smoothing; no held-out target plane enters inference
base_anatomy.nested_global_offset: selected inside each training fold only from [-0.50,-0.25,0.00,0.25,0.50] metres
base_anatomy.runtime_topology: deterministic CW8 regional contract and protected route

detail_target.definition: measured tangent-SDF plane minus the same plane smoothed with Gaussian sigma 1.5 pixels
detail_target.boundary_taper: raised cosine to zero at the editable-band exterior

arms.matched_procedural_detail: deterministic band-limited Gaussian displacement matched only to training-source-balanced residual RMS and two radial power bands
arms.rectified_flow_teacher: 8-step correlated residual flow conditioned on smooth retrieval plane, 22-dimensional local context, band mask, and deterministic seed
arms.one_step_student: feed-forward residual predictor distilled from frozen teacher samples and trained jointly against the measured residual

failure_policy.teacher_pass_student_fail: do not promote teacher; retain as research-only upper bound
failure_policy.both_learned_arms_fail: promote no learned CW9 detail; CW10 remains a portable deterministic/retrieval research candidate with explicit smooth-detail limitation
failure_policy.topology_or_seam_failure: fail closed regardless of visual quality

claim_limit: Named 12-cave development mechanism test for topology-safe local boundary detail; no population realism, causal speleogenesis, or unique growth-history claim
